name: Shura Daishi
original_name: 珠藍 大姉 (シュラ ダイシ)
source:
The leader of the Blue and a pureblood who was born on Tenguu Island.
She became the first woman to hold the position of a leader, replacing her late husband.
She is beloved by the people of the Blue, but for some reason she is cold towards [url=/c74512]Olympia[/url].

The Blue were granted the power to return souls to the heavens.

[spoiler]In "Catharsis" she has built a school for women and is working to improve their rights. She keeps a close eye on the island's developments in order to ensure that the next generation inherits the position of a leader of the Blue.
